register.title: Register and get verified

settle.title: Settle and receive provenance
settle.body: Pay securely, then receive the piece with its on-chain certificate.

provenance.title: Every sold piece carries its own certificate
provenance.body: When a lot settles, Auctory mints an ERC-721 certificate on the Sepolia network containing the lot reference, specialist report, and sale date. The certificate transfers with the object, so each future owner inherits a complete, tamper-evident ownership history.

sell.title: Have a piece worth the catalogue?
sell.body: Submit your item for a free specialist estimate. Approved consignors receive photography, cataloguing, and a reserve agreed in writing before the sale opens.
